description.en: A DeepSeek coding agent harness: persistent shell, Ultra subagents, auto approval, Chrome MCP and session telemetry
微信读书 dsh 插件：书架管理、年度书墙、阅读统计、AI 总结 | DeepSeek Harness plugin for WeChat Reading
description.zh: 通过微信读书 Skills API Key 提供书架、今日阅读、笔记日历、阅读统计、年度书墙、AI 总结与原文跳转的 Web 面板。

description.en: 【已归档】上游风控持续加强、UA/请求头格式频繁变动，适配已难以为继。后续开发移步 https://github.com/functy23/dsh-workbuddy-panel
description.zh: 已归档的 WorkBuddy 模型接入插件，把 WorkBuddy 渠道接进 DSH 当模型用，现已停止维护。

description.en: Visual annotation plugin for DeepSeek Harness: select elements in local app previews and send structured UI feedback to your agent.
description.zh: 在本地应用预览里直接圈选界面元素，把结构化的 UI 反馈发给 AI 助手，改起来更准。

description.en: 把单一会话不可能的巨任务拆成无数可验证子系统，大规模并行有纪律执行
description.zh: 把超大任务拆成可验证的小子系统，大规模并行执行，还能挂后台任务和长期目标

description.en: 把电脑上的 DSH 会话接到手机：手机直连电脑读取真实会话，不做本地镜像。公网只传文本。
基于官方 SuperAgent 原型的通用 DSH 插件：飞书应用接入、原生面板与 Router/Worker 会话。
AI Agent for Quantum Systems
Offline Unreal Engine 5.8 database for DeepSeek Harness
复用本机 ~/.codex 订阅凭证与 models_cache.json 模型缓存，在 DSH 中通过 SSE 直连调用 Codex 模型。
DeepSeek Harness plugin: the claude-design-system skill from baoyu-design. The agent writes design systems (tokens, type, components, assets) as files and opens them in a local design-system page.
MemOS Cloud lifecycle memory plugin for DeepSeek Harness
Gemini 紫夜主题与角色装饰 for DeepSeek Harness Desktop (Windows and macOS)
ComfyUI 任务池网关：统一入口排队分发到多张显卡的多个实例，合并 queue/history/system_stats；带账号隔离的远程控制台（工作流/历史/资产只属于本人、跨重启保留）、SFW/NSFW 分级、每工作流提示词表头、自然语言转提示词与知识库检索。
Two-phase long-term memory plugin for DeepSeek Harness (DSH): per-session extraction + global consolidation, always-injected summary, and memory_list/read/search/add tools.
DeepSeek Harness 插件：让 agent 默认用中文思考与回复（移植自 superpowers-zh）
Permanently delete DSH sessions from the file system, right from the sidebar conversation menu — 在 DSH 侧边栏菜单真正物理删除会话，而非归档隐藏。

DSH company collaboration mode: companies, employee accounts, groups with an auto-joined AI member, persistent server-side DSH ACP host with SSE streaming activity and group approvals, and local Git AI tasks.

dsh-voice-say：把一句话合成语音（本机 Breeze TTS 2，离线免费）。上传一段音频就是嗓子——逐字转写可以不用手打，插件用本地 faster-whisper 自动听写（也可自己指定 python / 装识别环境）；主参数两个——instructions（自然语言写「怎么说话」）与 guidanceScale；18 个风格可叠加；音色可存库、可指定 QQ 桥接用哪个嗓子（设了就只认它，文件丢了直接报错不退回默认）。合成前「读音导演」按人设、当下情绪与对话情节重排标点（只动标点不改字）。Q
星汐：把整理好的记忆档案连成一张看得见的星图。八章散成星群，日记排成时间星带，点一颗星看见原话。
description.zh: 把整理好的记忆档案铺成一张能点的星图——一条记忆一颗星，日记在外圈排成时间星带，另有星册、星历，以及把每天的原始对话收进档案的「拾星」。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness (DSH) 代码仓库插件：用 GitHub 官方 Octokit 和 GitBeaker 抹平 GitHub / GitLab（含 GitHub Enterprise 与自建 GitLab）差异，对外提供 dshRepos 服务，并为模型提供代码、issue、PR/MR、CI 工具；Web 组合中在左侧栏「代码仓库」页面配置全部参数
Embedded identity and payment-governance trust plane for multi-agent cross-border payment workflows.
A focused end-user QA surface backed by native DeepSeek Harness sessions
DSH 插件：右侧栏常驻「余额明细」——DeepSeek 余额、赠送钱包，以及今日 token 消耗（本机 DSH 会话 + 平台全部 API Key，重叠时按平台口径只算一次）/ 命中 / 未命中 / 输出 / 消费金额 / API 请求次数。

Sync your DeepSeek Harness (DSH) configuration between machines over a private git or WebDAV channel: settings, plugins, MCP servers, skills, agent presets and provider credentials. DSH 配置远程同步插件（私有通道，明文自用）。
DSH SlideStudio — AI presentations with editable PPTX export for DeepSeek Harness
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 中生成和编辑演示文稿，并导出可编辑的 PPTX 文件。

description.en: BioCore DSH UI: per-session state tab, standalone instrument panel, /api/biocore/state, session/event one_turn updates, /bio sync.
Assistant reply-body translation for the DeepSeek Harness Web UI (OpenAI-compatible channel)
Drive the desktop and Chrome from DeepSeek Harness using the computer-use runtime inside the ChatGPT desktop application.
description.zh: 让 DeepSeek Harness 通过 LCU 直接操控桌面和 Chrome，不用打开应用就能自动干活。

description.en: DSH 插件：每天替你刷一轮 B站 —— 读字幕挑出值得的、每条写一份笔记，值得的就 @ 你

给大肥鱼会话用的 QQ 群/私聊工具（只支持 SnowLuma，其他 OneBot 实现包括 NapCat 都不支持）：列群、看群记录、发群消息（可引用/@）、发表情、收藏表情（SnowLuma 收藏夹）、好友/私聊记录、发私聊消息、私聊唤醒、群成员、戳一戳感知/戳回去、更改头像、好友管理（资料/备注/分组/删好友/名片赞/好友申请）、QQ 空间说说（列表/详情/发表/评论/点赞/权限）、挂载会话选择。11 个工具组加 1 个设置组件，可在插件页逐个开关。
description.zh: 在 DSH 里直接收发 QQ 群聊和私聊消息，还能发表情、戳一戳、翻历史记录。

description.en: Task gate for the DeepSeek Harness: every conversation must end by declaring complete, wait, or blocked; undeclared stops are nudged, and abnormal sessions are revived after a host restart.
把「视觉伴侣页面上的提交」变成一条用户消息：用户在网页上点选、写备注、按提交，DSH 会话自动起一轮继续工作，不必回终端复述。
Unofficial OpenAI Codex provider for DeepSeek Harness with ChatGPT subscription sign-in.
DeepSeek Harness 插件 — 环评文件核对：依据《环境影响评价技术导则》系列《环境影响评价技术导则 总纲》（各导则现行版本号本次未逐一核实）。仅提示差异，不作出定性结论。
description.zh: 核对环评导则适用性表，检查要素与导则编号是否可追溯、规范。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness 插件 — PPAP 提交资料核对：依据《生产件批准程序（PPAP）手册》。仅提示差异，不作出定性结论。
description.zh: 自动核对 PPAP 提交要素清单，检查客户要求的要素是否有提交记录，帮你快速发现漏交项。

description.en: AI Book Shelf / AI 书架：书籍与论文阅读、AI 解释、全文搜索、论文翻译与中英对照
description.zh: 在 DSH 里读电子书和论文，AI 帮你解释内容、全文搜索，还能翻译论文做中英对照。

description.en: Editable PowerPoint authoring workflow (a DSH-skill adaptation of icip-cas/PPTAgent) with concise Chinese business styling, HTML slide rendering and PPTX export review. Linux/WSL or macOS only; first use requires LibreOffice, Chinese fonts and a one-time setup step that installs Python/uv and Playwright Chromium.
description.zh: 可编辑 PowerPoint 制作工作流（基于 icip-cas/PPTAgent 的 Skill 版本改造），包含简洁中文商业风格、HTML 幻灯片渲染与 PPTX 导出复查。仅 Linux/WSL 或 macOS；首次使用需先装 LibreOffice、中文字体，并执行一次 setup 安装 Python/uv 与 Playwright Chromium。

description.en: Codex History Rail adds a Codex-style turn rail to the left gutter of a DSH conversation, with hover previews, click-to-jump, and saved favorites.
description.zh: CODEX 历史摘要条 —— 在 DSH 对话左侧留白处加入 Codex 风格回合时间轴，支持悬停预览、点击跳转与收藏。

description.en: Reads ComfyUI PNG metadata in a model-facing comfy_png_inspect tool: point it at one PNG or a whole output folder and it reports, per image, the LoRA execution chain with every strength value, sampler settings, base model, CLIP, VAE, latent size, both prompts and bypassed nodes.
description.zh: 以面向模型的 comfy_png_inspect 工具读取 ComfyUI 生成图的 PNG 元数据：可传单张 PNG 或整个 output 目录，逐张报出 LoRA 执行链与每档强度、采样参数、底模、CLIP、VAE、latent 尺寸、正负提示词与被 bypass 的节点。

description.en: Per-workspace personal knowledge base for DeepSeek Harness: each identity gets an isolated local library — import PDF, Word, Excel, Markdown, text, HTML and images, auto-chunk and embed into SQLite with FTS5 + vector hybrid retrieval, then ask questions in chat with numbered citations back to the source. Local-first, no cloud upload; vector embeddings need a local Ollama (default bge-m3), and without it retrieval degrades to FTS5 keyword search.
description.zh: 按工作区隔离的个人知识库：每种身份一套本地资料库，导入 PDF、Word、Excel、Markdown、文本、网页和图片，自动切块并生成向量索引（SQLite FTS5 + 向量混合检索），对话里直接提问，回答带编号引用可回溯原文。本地存储，不上传云端；向量化需要本机 Ollama（默认 bge-m3），没有时检索退化为 FTS5 关键词。

description.en: Registers bundled full-stack, frontend-design and browser-automation skill documents as four read-only tools; a focus argument selects which reference file is returned alongside the skill body.
description.zh: 把内置的全栈开发、前端设计与浏览器自动化三份技能文档注册为四个只读工具，用 focus 参数指定随技能正文一并返回的参考文档。

description.en: Right-click any selected assistant reply and add it to the composer as a removable quote chip. The selected text is delivered to the model as hidden context, so your message bubble keeps only your own words.
description.zh: 选中助手回复中的一段文字，右键即可「加入对话」，以可移除的引用胶囊放进输入框；发送时原文作为隐藏上下文交给模型，消息气泡里只保留你自己的话。

description.en: ADHD-friendly focus soundscape docked under the DSH composer: five procedurally synthesised noise colours (white, pink, brown, rain, fan), a live-waveform orb, a 15-90 minute fade-out timer and a liquid-glass popover. No audio assets and no network requests.
description.zh: DSH 输入框下方的 ADHD 友好专注声景：白/粉/棕噪与雨声、风扇五种程序化合成音色，实时波形声球、15–90 分钟定时淡出与液态玻璃浮层；无音频素材、无网络请求。

description.en: Injects the non-obvious operating rules of Agent Teams into the Lead session through one ordered system-prompt section: plan the roster before spawning, roster slots are never released, write scopes are advisory, and wait_agent short-circuits when no peer is running.
description.zh: 通过一条有序的 system-prompt 段落把 Agent Teams 的隐性操作规则注入 Lead 会话：先规划名额再派员、名额不可回收、写入范围只是约定、没有同伴在跑时 wait_agent 会立刻返回。

description.en: Left-sidebar panel that views, edits and saves ~/.dsh/AGENTS.md live, with version-guarded saves and atomic writes.
description.zh: 左侧栏面板，实时查看、修改并保存 ~/.dsh/AGENTS.md；保存带版本校验，写入是原子替换。

description.en: View and edit the AGENTS.md / CLAUDE.md instruction chain in a native right-sidebar tab — global, shared, and every project directory down to the session working directory — with in-place save that creates missing files, a chat-header toggle, and an /agents command that works without the panel.
description.zh: 在右侧栏原生 tab 里查看并编辑 AGENTS.md / CLAUDE.md 指令链：全局、共享，以及从项目根到会话工作目录的每一层；就地保存，文件不存在时直接创建；另有聊天头部按钮，以及界面不可用时也能用的 /agents 命令。

description.en: API key switcher for DeepSeek Harness: save multiple API keys in Settings and switch the active one; the next model request uses it, with no DSH restart.
description.zh: DSH 多 API Key 管理：在设置里保存多把 Key 并一键切换，下一次模型请求即生效，无需重启 DSH。

description.en: A floating VRM avatar with tool-driven expressions and VRMA animations, plus model and motion asset management.
description.zh: 常驻界面的 VRM 数字人，支持通过工具控制表情与 VRMA 动作，并提供模型和动作资产管理。

description.en: Balance strip in the composer dock — a green-to-red OKLCH ramp driven by your DeepSeek balance, with a dynamic toggle, texture options and a built-in settings panel.
description.zh: 输入框下方状态行里的余额状态条：色带随余额在绿与红之间变化，可关动态、换纹理，并带图形化设置面板。

description.en: Sets the UI text colour for light and dark themes separately, plus the body font size and the interface typeface, with system Kai/Xing/Li/Song families, four open-source calligraphy fonts and support for importing your own font file.
description.zh: 分别设置深浅主题的文字颜色，并调整正文字号与界面字体：内置楷体、行楷、隶书等系统字体，附带四款开源书法字体，也能导入自己的字体文件。

description.en: Registers 12 CatPaw (妙手) models as a DeepSeek Harness provider, with per-model reasoning effort, harness-executed tool calls, and QR-code login. The bundled catpaw-cli is a macOS arm64 binary (other platforms must supply their own copy), and calls use the signed-in CatPaw account quota.
description.zh: 把妙手（CatPaw）的 12 个模型接入 DeepSeek Harness，支持按模型区分的推理档位、由 Harness 执行的工具调用与扫码登录。内置 catpaw-cli 仅提供 macOS arm64 版本（其它平台需自备），调用消耗妙手账号额度。

description.en: DSH plugin: three MCP tool servers for DingTalk (via the dws CLI), Feishu (via lark-cli) and Feishu Project (via the official @lark-project/mcp), reusing the accounts dws and lark-cli are already logged in with, plus a Feishu Project MCP user token you paste in the panel; once the three connectors are connected, the default set is 140 tools (47 DingTalk, 45 Feishu, 48 Feishu Project) under the mcp__dingtalk__ / mcp__feishu__ / mcp__meego__ prefixes. A sidebar panel adds a connector wall with one-click connect (installs the CLI and walks through device-code login, or takes the Feishu Project token), custom MCP connections pasted as mcpServers JSON, enable/disable per connection, the write-tool switch, and a searchable catalog of the 1098 dws and 246 lark-cli commands.
description.zh: DSH 插件：把钉钉（走 dws CLI）、飞书（走 lark-cli）和飞书项目（走官方 @lark-project/mcp）做成三个 MCP 工具服务器，钉钉与飞书复用这两个 CLI 已登录的账号，飞书项目需在面板里填入 MCP 用户令牌；三个连接器都连好后默认注册 140 个工具（钉钉 47、飞书 45、飞书项目 48），前缀分别是 mcp__dingtalk__ / mcp__feishu__ / mcp__meego__。侧边栏面板提供连接器墙（一键连接：装 CLI 并走设备码登录，或填飞书项目令牌）、粘贴 mcpServers JSON 添加自定义 MCP、逐条启停、写工具开关，以及可搜索的 1098 条 dws 与 246 条 lark-cli 命令目录。

description.en: Quote selected text from a DSH message into the composer as a blue chip, hover to read the full quote, and remove it with X or Backspace; sent quotes reach the model as a blockquote.
description.zh: 划选 DSH 消息中的文字，右键引用为输入框里的蓝色小块；悬停查看全文，点 ✕ 或按 Backspace 删除；发送后引用以 blockquote 原文交给模型。

description.en: Prompt-driven code audit tasks for DeepSeek Harness with vulnerability tracking, live progress, and exportable reports that include PoC request examples.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 代码审计插件：按所选提示词执行审计任务，跟踪漏洞与实时进度，导出包含 PoC 请求包的专业报告。

description.en: Compare Git/SVN versions across repositories and export Chinese Markdown release reports with optional approved model analysis.
description.zh: 比较多个 Git/SVN 项目的版本差异，导出中文 Markdown 发布报告，并可明确授权模型分析。

description.en: Drive locally installed Codex CLI and Claude Code from DeepSeek Harness through a settings page and agent tools, exposing their sessions, configuration and run state.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 中驱动本机安装的 Codex CLI 与 Claude Code，通过设置页与 agent 工具查看会话、配置和运行状态。

description.en: Adds a red delete row to the sidebar session menu, plus a multi-select delete that confirms before running, and permanently removes the stored data behind a conversation — session directory and log, projection-cache record, workspace membership and pin.
description.zh: 在侧栏会话菜单加入红色「删除对话」，并支持多选批量删除（二次确认），永久清除对话的磁盘数据——会话目录与日志、投影缓存记录、工作区归属与置顶。

description.en: Cooking recipes in DSH: a full panel in the Web GUI plus four recipe_* tools for the agent. 373 home-cooking recipes — mostly Chinese, with Western, Japanese and Korean dishes mixed in — bundled with 347 dish photos and three kitchen-tip illustrations; the dataset is derived from the open-source HowToCook project (Unlicense) and was cleaned, unit-repaired and re-typeset for this plugin. Browse by dish, category or the ingredients you already have, get a daily pick, keep favourites and cooked marks, and read kitchen tips. Everything ships inside the plugin: offline, no hotlinking, no telemetry.
description.zh: 菜谱面板 + 4 个 recipe_* 工具：373 道家常菜谱（以中式为主，兼收西式与日韩菜式），随包附带 347 张菜品图与 3 张厨房技巧插图，数据取自开源项目 HowToCook（Unlicense）并经清洗、单位修正与重排。按菜名、分类或手头食材找菜，每日推荐、收藏与「做过」标记、厨房技巧；数据随插件分发，离线可用，不热链、无遥测。

description.en: Shows the official COT machine translation inside dsh-better-display's reading view, with a per-card original/translated toggle on better-display 0.3.12 and later.
description.zh: 在 dsh-better-display 的阅读页显示官方「思考过程机器翻译」译文，并在 better-display 0.3.12 及以上提供按卡片切换原文/译文。

description.en: macOS Computer Use for DeepSeek Harness: the agent reads accessibility trees, captures screenshots and drives real desktop apps, mounted on the 0.2.1-rc.5 line with a separately built native helper. macOS only.
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 接入 macOS 电脑操控：agent 读取辅助功能树、截图并驱动真实桌面应用，挂在 0.2.1-rc.5 这条线上，原生 helper 需单独构建。仅支持 macOS。

description.en: Dynamics 365 CE / Dataverse toolkit for DSH: 15 tools for querying metadata and solution layers across environments, snapshots and diffs, field impact analysis, migration risk assessment, GitLab merge-request checks, contract drift, environment health, and review-gated metadata writes.
description.zh: 面向 Dynamics 365 CE / Dataverse 的 DSH 工具箱：15 个工具，支持跨环境查询元数据与解决方案层、快照与差异、字段影响面反查、迁移风险评估、GitLab MR 检查、契约漂移、环境健康，以及需人工确认的元数据写入。

description.en: A desktop pet for DSH: a blue whale girl with 104 animations and built-in voice. It is standalone, but its pet runtime is a rework of dsh-dafeiyu — disable the upstream dsh-dafeiyu before installing, or both will run and fight over the control port. Windows x64 only, and the first launch downloads about 580 MB of assets.
description.zh: DSH 桌宠：蓝色鲸鱼娘，自带 104 个动作与内置语音。插件独立，但桌宠运行时基于 dsh-dafeiyu 改造——安装前需先禁用上游 dsh-dafeiyu，否则两只同开会抢控制口；仅支持 Windows x64，首次启动需下载约 580MB 素材。

description.en: Every night generates the companion character's schedule for the next day with DSH's configured model, from the persona (AGENT.md by default) and a weighted day type (work, rest, outing, home, overtime, slacking, or your own); injects the date, time, current activity and what comes next into the system prompt, with a speaking-style note so the character does not recite a timetable; adds schedule_view and schedule_adjust tools and a /life command that turns the injection on or off per session. With aa1355721445-lgtm/dsh-image-studio installed, each entry gets an outfit, scene and props from its libraries. A settings page shows today's and tomorrow's timelines and edits day types.
description.zh: 每晚用 DSH 已配置的模型，按人设（默认读 AGENT.md）和按权重抽到的日程类型（上班、休息、外出、宅家、加班、摸鱼，也可自定义）生成陪伴角色第二天的全天日程；把日期、时间、此刻在做什么、接下来做什么注入系统提示，并附一段说话方式，避免角色念时间表；提供 schedule_view、schedule_adjust 工具和按会话开关注入的 /life 指令。装了生图工作室（aa1355721445-lgtm/dsh-image-studio）时，每段日程会配上素材库里的穿搭、场景和物品。设置页可查看今天和明天的时间线、编辑日程类型。

description.en: Resumable multi-connection downloader with China mirror and proxy presets, plus DeepSeek-assisted resource discovery.
description.zh: 支持断点续传、多连接加速、国内镜像/代理预置与 DeepSeek 资源发现的下载器。

description.en: Declarative DAG runtime for DSH tool plans with bounded parallel execution, read-only retries, per-step checkpoints, cancellation, and conservative crash recovery.
description.zh: DSH 工具计划的声明式 DAG 运行时，支持有界并行、只读重试、逐步落盘、取消及保守的崩溃恢复。

description.en: Optional external HTTP API for DSH Desktop, off by default, bound to localhost unless widened, and authenticated with a Bearer token.
description.zh: DSH Desktop 的可选外部 HTTP API，默认关闭、默认仅监听本机，扩大监听范围时使用 Bearer Token 鉴权。

description.en: Replaces the sidebar workspace Files pane with a file manager that adds real composer chips for "@" file mentions, word and line selection across syntax highlighting, archives in and out, upload and download, and a jump menu to any directory on the machine.
description.zh: 把侧边栏「工作区文件」面板换成文件管理器：加入对话时生成与输入框 @ 选文件一致的 chip，语法高亮下可双击选词、三击选行，支持压缩解压、上传下载，并可跳转到机器上任意目录。

description.en: Local LoRA and QLoRA fine-tuning in a panel: import JSONL, see a VRAM estimate before training starts, evaluate, and export an adapter. One-click Python venv setup, but you must supply your own Python 3.10+ and an NVIDIA GPU (6 GB or more). Verified end to end on Windows 11 with an RTX 3060 6 GB; the installer refuses non-Windows hosts, so Linux, macOS and other GPUs are unsupported for now.
description.zh: 面板里的本地 LoRA / QLoRA 微调：导入 JSONL、开始前先看显存估算、评测并导出适配器。一键创建 Python 虚拟环境，但需自备 Python 3.10+ 与 NVIDIA 显卡（6 GB 显存起）。已在 Windows 11 + RTX 3060 6 GB 上完整跑通；安装器会直接拒绝非 Windows 平台，Linux、macOS 与其他显卡暂不支持。

description.en: Page-level startup splash: a Penrose triangle light sweep over a living isometric diamond ocean, where the frame itself is the progress gauge, paced by the intro but capped by real DSH boot milestones. Any bare key skips it, ten palettes come from Monument Valley and Geometric Islands, and when the intro ends the triangle stays on as a small mark beside the composer that reflects what the agent is doing.
description.zh: 页面级启动开屏：彭罗斯三角在等距菱格海面上旋转受光，取景框本身就是进度计，按开屏节奏平滑推进、以真实 DSH 启动完成度为上限；按任意键跳过，主题坞提供 Monument Valley / Geometric Islands 十套色板。开屏结束后三角留在输入框旁，作为一枚反映当前工作状态的小标记。

description.en: Sync DeepSeek Harness sessions and workspace files to a private GitHub repository for cross-device handoff, with sync badges, search and bulk upload, independent local/remote delete, conflict "pick a side", and multi-device-safe index merging.
description.zh: 把 DSH 会话与工作区文件同步到私有 GitHub 仓库，实现跨设备接力；支持同步徽标、搜索与批量上传、本地/远端独立删除、冲突选边，以及多设备安全的索引合并。

description.en: Keep pinned conversations from every workspace at the top of the sidebar, with drag insertion hints, manual or recent-first sorting, and completion-unread dots. Includes Codex-style row actions: a live spinning indicator while a session runs, archive and restore, inline rename that selects the whole title, and a right-click menu for fork and reordering. A magnifier beside the Global pins heading opens a search overlay: it matches session titles and workspace names instantly, then searches message content through the Host index when the deployment enables it, splitting results under small Sessions and Content headings with snippets.
description.zh: 会话散落在不同工作区，重要内容不好找？全局置顶把你选中的会话集中到侧边栏顶部，支持拖拽排序和清晰的插入位置提示，也可按最近更新时间自动排序。会话完成后小绿点提醒。还有 Codex 同款行内操作：运行中的会话右侧持续转圈显示进度，支持归档/恢复、点开就全选标题的重命名，右键菜单可 Fork 和上下移动。侧边栏「全局置顶」旁的放大镜打开搜索浮层：先按会话标题和工作区名匹配，再查消息正文索引（部署开启内容索引时可用），结果按「会话」「内容」小标题分组，内容命中带摘要。

description.en: Streams a running Godot game into a DSH sidebar panel as MJPEG by driving a native Godot process, so Forward+ projects and GDExtensions keep working. The panel can start, stop, capture and fullscreen the view and inject clicks, and the agent gets tools to read status, drive input and take screenshots.
description.zh: 通过驱动原生 Godot 进程把运行中的游戏画面以 MJPEG 推进 DSH 侧栏面板，Forward+ 项目与 GDExtension 都照常工作。面板可启动、停止、抓帧、全屏并注入点击，agent 另有工具读取状态、注入输入与截图。

description.en: Group installed DSH plugins into named sets and enable, disable or exclusively apply them by rewriting the profile bundle list. Can also render a set as an agent preset that a single conversation uses.
description.zh: 把已装插件编成命名分组，一键启用、停用或独占应用（改写 profile 的 bundle 清单）；还能把分组写成 agent 预设，让单个对话只开这一组。

description.en: Read-only Home Assistant panel for DeepSeek Harness: a full status overview, a compact right-sidebar card, a system-prompt environment block, one read-only ha_status tool, and optional browser notifications on Home Assistant down/recover. Configure the instance URL and token once; it does not control devices or change Home Assistant configuration.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的 Home Assistant 只读面板：完整状态总览、右侧栏速览卡、系统提示词环境块、一个只读 ha_status 工具，以及可选的 HA 不可用/恢复浏览器通知。配置一次实例地址与令牌；不控制设备，也不修改 Home Assistant 配置。

description.en: Left-sidebar panel that browses the filesystem of the machine the Harness runs on: directory listings with sizes and modification times, text and image previews, file downloads, file uploads into the open directory, and folder creation. The panel speaks twelve languages. Reads and writes run with the privileges of the account that runs the Harness.
description.zh: 左侧边栏面板，浏览运行 Harness 的宿主机文件系统：带大小与修改时间的目录列表、文本与图片预览、文件下载、向当前目录上传文件，以及新建文件夹。面板支持十二种语言。读写操作使用运行 Harness 的账户权限。

description.en: Adds a composer control that turns a plain-language draft into a structured, terminology-precise prompt, shows the professional term behind selected colloquial phrases with a one-line explanation, and offers a terms-only mode that returns professional terminology without rewriting the draft.
description.zh: 在输入框工具行增加「译」按钮：把口语草稿改写成结构清晰、术语准确的专业提示词，并把其中若干口语表达对照成专业术语、各附一句解释；「只查术语」模式只返回专业说法，不改写草稿。

description.en: Reader-first long-form fiction pipeline with outline-first chapters, 14 gate scripts, a 700-seed theme library and a self-test for every script (the scripts run on the host's Python 3).
description.zh: 读者优先的长篇小说工序：细纲先行、14 个门禁脚本、700 条主题种子，每个脚本自带自检（脚本依赖宿主上的 Python 3 运行）。

description.en: Offline civil-service exam study panel integrating 15 upstream open-source question banks with SRS wrong-book, mock exams, essay grading, interactive knowledge graph and whitebox observability. The npm package ships no question-bank data: after install, the required set (~363 MB) is cloned from the question-bank manager (all 15 upstream repos are about 2.2 GB).
description.zh: 离线公务员备考学习面板，整合 15 个上游开源题库，提供 SRS 错题本、整卷模考、申论离线评改、可交互知识图谱与白盒可观测。npm 包不含题库数据：安装后需在题库管理里克隆必选包（约 363 MB，15 个上游仓库全量约 2.2 GB）。

description.en: Clamps the session history page request to 120 messages and replaces request/header tool schemas larger than 200k characters with an empty array before React renders them, so long sessions open without freezing the transcript.
description.zh: 把打开会话时的历史取数收到 120 条消息，并在进入 React 之前把超过 20 万字符的工具 schema 换成空数组，让长会话打开时不再卡死界面。

description.en: Phone access to the DSH web UI: LAN pairing plus remote access through your own tunnel command (e.g. cloudflared) or a fixed public URL, with automatic LAN-to-tunnel failover and dshlanpair:// deep links; the phone client is the bundled Android app (APK, Android 8+, sideloaded).
description.zh: 手机接入 DSH Web 界面：内网配对 + 通过自备隧道命令（如 cloudflared）或固定公网地址的远程访问，自带局域网到隧道的自动降级与 dshlanpair:// 深链接；手机端需侧载仓库自带的 Android App（APK，需 Android 8+）。

description.en: Keeps a model request alive through a dropped connection: transport failures retry until the network returns while real errors still fail fast, and a turn killed by a process crash offers a one-click, state-checking continuation.
description.zh: 断网时不让模型请求死掉：连接类失败会重试到网络恢复，而真正的错误仍然立刻失败；被进程崩溃打断的一轮还会给出一键续跑，先核对状态再继续。

description.en: Vietnamese (tiếng Việt) language pack for the DeepSeek Harness Web UI: hand-translated dictionaries for 61 namespaces (3,477 strings) that take effect when Vietnamese is picked in Settings → Language, plus a /vi-sync command that translates strings added by newer plugin versions through the harness translator service.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web UI 增加越南语：61 个命名空间、3,477 条人工翻译词条，在「设置 → 语言」里选中越南语即生效；另带 /vi-sync 命令，用 Harness 内置翻译服务补译新版本新增的字符串。

description.en: MCP server panel for the DeepSeek Harness Web GUI: the sidebar lists every @deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client row — including rows inserted by other plugins — with a connection state derived from the loader fiber plus the mcp__<server>__* tool count, shows that row's configuration, enables or disables it by editing only that row of the patch file, and reconnects once after a failed attempt.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness Web GUI 的 MCP 服务器面板：侧边栏列出每一个 @deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client 行（含其它插件插入的行），用 loader fiber 状态加上 mcp__<server>__* 工具数判断真实连接状态，可展开看该行配置，开关只改补丁文件里对应的一行并触发热重载重连，连接失败后自动再试一次。

description.en: Local media toolbox for DeepSeek Harness: converts files between 27 video, audio and image formats, trims clips, extracts audio or video tracks without re-encoding, exports embedded subtitles to .srt, compresses images with a before/after preview, reads and rewrites metadata, and encodes or decodes Base64 — all through the ffmpeg already installed on the machine, so files never leave it. The same engine is registered as a media_toolbox tool agents can call.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的本地多媒体工具箱：27 种视频/音频/图片格式互转、裁剪、不重编码地剥离音轨或画面、导出内嵌字幕为 .srt、带前后对比预览的图片压缩、元数据查看与改写、Base64 编解码——全部走本机已装的 ffmpeg，文件不出本机；同一引擎也注册为 agent 可调用的 media_toolbox 工具。

description.en: Read-only persona injection for DSH: when a session opens inside your workspace, your persona files and the latest diary entries are prepended to the system prompt, and those source files are never modified. It keeps a short cross-session feed of recent messages under <root>/live/feed.json and can write a QQ hand-off file at <root>/live/web-for-qq.md; nothing is uploaded. Variable blocks (clock, recent actions, other sessions) are delivered as a per-step context message, so the prompt prefix stays byte-stable and keeps its cache.
description.zh: DSH 的开场记忆插件：会话开在指定目录时，把人格文件与最近几篇日记注入系统提示词，这些源文件只读不改；它会在 <root>/live/feed.json 保存一小段跨会话的最近对话，并可写出 <root>/live/web-for-qq.md 交给 QQ 侧，不上传任何内容。会变的块（时间感、刚做过、别的会话）走每步刷新的上下文消息，系统提示逐字节稳定，前缀缓存不被打断。

description.en: Connect DeepSeek Harness to the local Codex CLI with dynamic model discovery, image input, Harness-owned tools, and read-only ChatGPT plan and quota display.
description.zh: 通过本机 Codex CLI 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供动态模型发现、图片输入、Harness 工具调用及 ChatGPT 套餐与额度只读展示。

description.en: After user setup, guides native subagents toward model preferences by task type, using native model-selection permissions with no extra routing-model calls.
description.zh: 配置模型偏好后，引导原生子 agent 按任务类型选择模型；沿用原生授权，不额外调用路由模型。

description.en: Drag the two handles to resize and move the DSH chat area as a floating window; position and size persist across reloads, and movement is clamped to the conversation pane so it never leaves the screen.
description.zh: 拖动两个把手调整 DSH 对话区的大小与位置，把整块对话变成可任意摆放的浮窗；位置与尺寸自动记住，移动范围限制在对话窗格内，不会跑出屏幕。

description.en: Adds a work-without-a-project option to the project picker, creates a dated working directory from the first message, and groups these sessions under a native Recent section.
description.zh: 为不属于任何项目的会话提供「不在项目中工作」选项，按首条消息在 ~/Documents/dsh/<日期>/ 下创建可读的独立工作目录，并在侧栏「最近」分区集中展示。

description.en: A countdown pill under the message composer showing how long is left before you clock off, with a workday progress bar; click it to set your own start and end times (saved in this browser), and after the end time it turns into an overtime timer.
description.zh: 输入框下方常驻的倒计时胶囊：显示距离下班还剩多久，并带一条工作日进度条；点开可设置自己的上下班时间（只存在本机浏览器），到点后转为加班计时。

description.en: One-person-company operations SOP for DeepSeek Harness: 8-field company profile, a daily cycle from morning brief through two execution shifts to an evening report, ledger and cash-snapshot conventions, quote/contract shapes, and six red lines with a human-approval outbox.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的一人公司运营 SOP：8 字段建公司档案，晨报→两档执行→晚报的日循环，台账与现金流快照口径，报价/合同/日报形状，以及六条红线与待发池人审。

description.en: Adds lasting bots with their own name, photo, persona, memory, voice and model, a Bots panel in the sidebar, and a hidden helper subagent per bot that follows the conversation, searches ahead and leaves notes the bot reads; voice uses your own ElevenLabs, OpenAI, Groq, Mistral or Deepgram key. Interface and prompts in Brazilian Portuguese.
description.zh: 添加长期存在的机器人，每个都有自己的名字、头像、人设、记忆、声音和模型，侧边栏提供 Bots 面板；每个机器人背后有一个隐藏的辅助子代理，跟随对话、提前搜索并留下供机器人阅读的笔记；语音使用你自己的 ElevenLabs、OpenAI、Groq、Mistral 或 Deepgram 密钥。界面和提示词为巴西葡萄牙语。

description.en: Folds the DSH sidebar's global panel launchers into the More button it already renders, so the workspace and session list below regains up to seven 36px rows. A row in the More menu toggles the fold back, and the choice is kept in localStorage.
description.zh: 把 DSH 侧边栏的全局面板入口收进它本来就有的『更多』按钮，下面的工作区与会话列表最多多出七行 36px 的高度；『更多』菜单里一行开关即可还原，选择记在 localStorage 里。

description.en: Host-side dsh plugin that pairs a phone to a dsh instance through a self-hosted relay: one outbound connection carries the session list, streaming chat, approvals, attachments and file previews to a dedicated mobile web shell, and devices pair with a one-time QR link and can be revoked from a console inside the dsh web GUI.
description.zh: dsh 的 Host 侧插件：经自托管中继把手机配到 dsh 实例，一条出站连接承载会话列表、流式对话、审批、附件与文件预览，送达专用手机网页壳；设备用一次性二维码链接配对，可在 dsh 网页内的控制台随时撤销。

description.en: White-box testing workflow skill for embedded C: host-side stub harness, wb.py test driver with gcov coverage gating, and a control-logic study handbook template.
description.zh: 嵌入式 C 白盒测试工作流技能：宿主机打桩 harness、wb.py 测试驱动与 gcov 覆盖率门禁、控制逻辑学习手册模板。

description.en: Host plugin that adds the /dsh-plugin-book-deconstruct command and the dsh-plugin-book-deconstruct tool to any session for a full book walkthrough plus one deep insight.
description.zh: Host 插件：任意会话可用 /dsh-plugin-book-deconstruct 命令与 dsh-plugin-book-deconstruct 工具，输入书名与作者后讲透全书并给出一段深度思想。

description.en: A settings-tab workshop plus the cordis-plugin-development skill it hands to the agent, for writing DSH plugins against the running host API.
description.zh: 设置页里的插件工坊，附带交给 Agent 的 cordis-plugin-development 技能，基于当前运行的主机 API 编写 DSH 插件。

description.en: Selection comments on assistant output plus an independent side-chat window in the DSH Web GUI: annotate model output with floating comments, send those comments with the next message, and continue a question in a separate forked conversation that stays out of the sidebar.
description.zh: 在 DSH Web 界面中为大模型输出添加划词评论，评论可随下一条消息一起发送；并可在独立浮动的分支会话窗口中继续提问，该会话不会出现在侧边栏。

description.en: Mirrors a zero-valued Desktop release-age setting into profile policy and removes its Host environment alias to avoid unknown-policy update holds.
description.zh: 将桌面端零等待发布观察期同步到 profile 策略，并移除 Host 环境别名，避免市场更新被未知策略挂起。

description.en: Floating Pomodoro dial pinned to the bottom-right of the Harness UI: custom focus, short-break and long-break lengths, a long break that can be switched off entirely, a round counter, and five Web Audio-synthesized alarm sounds with preview, volume and ring duration. No audio assets and no network requests; timer state survives a reload.
description.zh: 常驻右下角的番茄钟圆盘：专注/短休/长休时长自定，长休可单独关闭，带轮次计数；闹铃为五种 Web Audio 实时合成的音效，支持试听、音量与响铃时长。无音频资源、无网络请求，计时状态刷新后继续。

description.en: Makes the agent narrate progress during long tool chains instead of staying silent until the final answer: a standing system-prompt rule that travels with every request, plus a notice injected after every N tool calls. A panel on the plugin page tunes the cadence, the reminder budget, and both texts; changes apply live.
description.zh: 让 agent 在长工具链中途说明进度，而不是一路静默到最终答复：一条随每次请求下发的常驻系统提示词规则，加上每 N 次工具调用后注入的一条提醒。插件页内的面板可调整步频、提醒上限与两段文本，保存即热生效。

description.en: PTC agent preset whose tools.guard refuses tool calls until the session holds an active goal and an in-progress todo.
description.zh: PTC 模式 agent preset：用 tools.guard 拒绝工具调用，直到会话里有进行中的目标和待办。

description.en: Qingshi diary and family-tree assistant: reads and writes career records, resolves relatives by kinship term, and drives the real H5 pages in a desktop window.
description.zh: 青史日记与族谱助手：读写生涯记录、按称谓倒推亲属关系，并在独立窗口里操作真实 H5 页面。

description.en: Second-model gate on the assistant turn, installed in two parts: copy engine/ into ~/.dsh/plugins/ and mount it by absolute path in the profile patch (the bundle itself only installs the settings panel), then switch off the default dry-run mode that only logs verdicts. Once active, a separate judge call scores the draft against the numbered criteria (0-10 each); any criterion under 6 fails the turn and sends it back for a rewrite, up to 3 rounds by default. The web panel edits criteria and thresholds, and every verdict is appended to an audit log.
description.zh: 助手回合收口前的第二模型质检，分两步安装：先把 engine/ 拷到 ~/.dsh/plugins/ 并在 profile 的 patch 中按绝对路径挂载（bundle 本身只装设置面板），再关掉默认的演习模式（只记日志、不打回）。启用后由独立判官调用按编号判据逐条打 0-10 分，任一条低于 6 分即判不合格并打回重写，默认最多回炉 3 轮；Web 面板编辑判据与阈值，每次判定写入审计日志。

description.en: QUASAR — a space-themed skin for DeepSeek Harness: an ink black hole in the sidebar and a live accretion disk rendered behind the app, with frosted-glass panels. Motion is canvas-driven and honors prefers-reduced-motion.
description.zh: QUASAR — DeepSeek Harness 的太空主题皮肤：侧栏里一颗墨色黑洞，应用背后实时渲染吸积盘，配合磨砂玻璃面板。动效由 canvas 驱动，尊重 prefers-reduced-motion。

description.en: Quote and reply the way Claude Code does it: select text, answer it in a popover, stack the pairs as blocks above the composer, send them as one message.
description.zh: 选中对话里的文字就地引用回复，问答变成输入框上方的方块，一次发出。

description.en: Adds three tools that hand DeepSeek Harness downloads to the Rayburst aria2 engine — rayburst_download, rayburst_wait and rayburst_status. Requires the Rayburst desktop app (aria2-next) installed and running on the same machine; the plugin reads its aria2.conf for the RPC port and secret.
description.zh: 把 DeepSeek Harness 的下载交给 Rayburst（aria2 引擎），提供 rayburst_download、rayburst_wait、rayburst_status 三个工具。需先在本机安装并运行 Rayburst 桌面端（aria2-next），插件会读取它的 aria2.conf 获取 RPC 端口与密钥。

description.en: Requirement-to-evidence audit for DSH sessions: maps each requirement to tool calls, files and commands, records per-requirement verification, and sends missing items back to the agent.
description.zh: Requirement-to-evidence audit for DSH sessions: maps each requirement to tool calls, files and commands, records per-requirement verification, and sends missing items back to the agent.

description.en: Scheduled prompts that open a fresh conversation for every run, with cron, one-time and manual triggers, a per-task working directory, and run history kept out of the sidebar.
description.zh: 定时提示词任务：每次运行新开一个对话，支持 cron、一次性与手动触发，可指定工作目录，运行记录不进左侧列表。

description.en: Read-only observer of native DeepSeek search model calls: appends each call token usage to a JSONL file so accounting plugins can price it. Requests and responses are not modified.
description.zh: 只读观察原生 DeepSeek 搜索的模型调用，把每次调用的 token 用量追加到 JSONL 文件，供统计类插件计价；不修改请求与响应。

description.en: Gives an agent tools to open foreground sessions, prompt them in queue or steer mode, read the transcript back, cancel a turn, and get the authenticated URL of the local web app.
description.zh: 给 agent 一组工具：打开前台会话、以排队或插队方式发提示词、读回转录、取消回合，以及拿到本机 Web 应用带认证的地址。

description.en: One main session coordinates several root sessions: a /relay command and 14 peer_* tools for batched status reports, a version-line notice, task-board claims, handoff and wake, read-only session inspection, and a web panel. Phone notifications need the DSHA device bridge.
description.zh: 由一个主会话协调多个平级会话：/relay 命令与 14 个 peer_* 工具，支持合并汇报、版本线公告、任务看板认领、交接与唤醒、只读查看会话，并带 Web 面板；手机通知需要 DSHA 设备桥。

description.en: Wall-clock session and turn timing for the DSH Web GUI: a timer chip in the session header shows the session total, every finished turn shows its own duration above the action row, and a sidebar panel totals today, the last 7 days, the last 30 days or all sessions. The numbers are folded from turn/start and turn/end in the session log, so paging, compaction and restarts do not change them.
description.zh: 给 DSH Web GUI 的会话与轮次墙钟计时：会话标题栏的计时胶囊显示会话累计耗时，每轮结束后在操作行上方显示本轮耗时，侧边栏「会话耗时」面板按今天、近 7 天、近 30 天或全部汇总。数字由会话日志里的 turn/start 与 turn/end 折叠而来，翻页、压缩上下文、重启都不影响。

description.en: Backs up and restores the whole DSH profile through a private Git repository: profile configuration, per-plugin settings, skills, installed plugins and MCP servers, with one-click backup and restore and a restore point written before anything is overwritten.
description.zh: 通过一个私有 Git 仓库备份与恢复整个 DSH profile：profile 配置、各插件设置、技能、已装插件与 MCP 服务器，提供一键备份与恢复，并在覆盖任何内容之前先写一个还原点。

description.en: DeepSeek balance and today's spend from the official usage export, in one line at the right end of the DSH sidebar account row; hovering opens a card with requests, tokens and the peak/off-peak countdown.
description.zh: 在 DSH 侧边栏账户行最右端一行显示 DeepSeek 余额与今日消费（官方用量口径），悬停展开请求数、token 与峰谷倒计时卡片。

description.en: Wallpaper layer behind the whole DeepSeek Harness Web UI, fed by image URLs, local files and folders, or a Wallpaper Engine workshop directory, with opacity, blur and translucent-panel sliders, a slideshow with random order and cross-fade, muted video playback, previous/next keyboard shortcuts, and a per-URL archive that keeps every fetched picture under "Loaded images".
description.zh: 给整个 DeepSeek Harness Web 界面铺一层壁纸：来源可以是图床直链、本地文件或目录、Wallpaper Engine 下载目录，可调壁纸透明度、模糊程度与界面不透明度，支持轮播、随机播放、交叉淡入淡出与静音视频播放，带上一张/下一张快捷键，并把每次从图床取回的图片按地址存档到「已加载图片」里。

description.en: Cache-first context compaction with an optional adaptive economic policy, observation-only by default, without cache-hit or cost-saving guarantees.
description.zh: 缓存优先的上下文压缩，提供可选的自适应经济策略，默认仅观察，不保证缓存命中或费用节省。

description.en: Map a remote server directory over SSH and SFTP into a controlled local cache workspace, so the model, agent, session and memory keep running on the local machine.
description.zh: 通过 SSH 与 SFTP 把服务器目录映射为受控的本地缓存工作区，模型、Agent、会话与记忆仍在本机运行。

description.en: Remembers the model used before quitting and restores it as the startup default.
description.zh: 自动记忆退出前选择的模型，并在下次启动时恢复为默认模型。

description.en: Adds a tiled board of colour-coded sticky notes to the sidebar: per-row density, pins, search and colour filters, a trash with restore, Markdown export, and note_* tools that read and write the same notes.
description.zh: 在左侧栏加一面可平铺的彩色便签墙：每行 2–5 个或自适应、置顶、搜索与颜色筛选、带恢复的回收站、Markdown 导出；四个 note_* 工具读写同一批便签。

description.en: External one-shot subagent provider using the local CodeBuddy CLI over ACP, with background result delivery and steering of running children.
description.zh: 通过 ACP 调用本机 CodeBuddy CLI 的外部一次性子智能体提供者，支持后台结果回传及向运行中的子智能体追加指令。

description.en: TAPD + ZenTao task hub for DSH: list assigned work in the sidebar and dispatch an agent on a branch you name.
description.zh: DSH 的 TAPD 与禅道任务中心：在侧边栏查看分配给自己的需求或任务，并在手动指定的分支上派发 Agent。

description.en: File-based task pool and dispatcher for DeepSeek Harness: keeps a P0-P3 backlog as Markdown, hands one task at a time to a background subagent, gates delivery by rerunning the project test command, and accepts the result against a git commit or a file snapshot; git and non-git directories both work.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的文件制任务池与调度器：用 Markdown 维护 P0–P3 待办，每次只把一个任务交给后台 subagent，重跑项目测试命令做机器验收，并按 git 提交或文件快照核对结果；git 与非 git 目录都能用。

description.en: Animal Island theme with boarding-pass masthead, cream notebook paper, 118 ThemeRuntime tokens, in-app appearance presets, and starry night mode.
description.zh: 动森风手账主题：渡岛船票品牌区、奶油手账纸、覆盖 118 项 ThemeRuntime token、应用内外观设置与夜岛星空。

description.en: A free, unofficial Cyrene-inspired theme for DeepSeek Harness with three palettes, a splash screen, and a chat watermark. Code is MIT; character fan art is excluded from MIT.
description.zh: 免费、非官方的「昔涟 / Cyrene」主题，含三套配色、开屏动画和对话水印；代码 MIT，角色同人素材不适用 MIT。

description.en: Global cyber-terminal theme: a click-through full-screen Matrix code-rain overlay, phosphor-green UI styling, a sidebar one-click toggle, and adjustable speed, density, opacity and glow with three palettes.
description.zh: 全局赛博终端主题：可点击穿透的全屏 Matrix 代码雨叠加层、荧光绿 UI 配色、侧边栏一键开关，以及可调的雨速、密度、透明度与发光和三套配色。

description.en: Text-to-speech service with Doubao TTS 2.0, Alibaba Bailian and OpenAI-compatible providers and a user-chosen voice; the agent speaks through tts_service_say, split into segments with an optional tone each, and other plugins can reuse ctx.ttsService.
description.zh: 多平台语音合成服务：豆包语音 2.0、阿里云百炼和 OpenAI 兼容接口，音色由用户选；助手用 tts_service_say 说话，可按语气分段、每段带一句语气描述，其他插件可复用 ctx.ttsService。

description.en: Shows elapsed time, tokens, tokens per second and a shrinking countdown estimate in the chat header for the running turn, and estimates output tokens, context size, cost and duration above the composer before you send.
description.zh: 对话头部实时显示本轮耗时、token、速度与只减不增的倒计时预估；发送前在输入框上方预估产出 token、上下文大小、费用与耗时。

description.en: Per-turn cost in CNY, with 本轮 / 今日 / 会话 totals shown above the composer. Tokens are priced by model and by the moment they were spent (peak hours and holidays); native DeepSeek search spend can be folded in when the optional audit plugin is installed.
description.zh: 按轮显示本轮花费（人民币），输入框上方常驻「本轮 / 今日 / 会话」合计；按模型与花费时刻计价（含峰谷与节假日），装了可选的搜索审计插件后可并入原生 DeepSeek 搜索费用。

description.en: Video study toolkit for DeepSeek Harness: fetch a public Bilibili single part or YouTube video, sample every 3 seconds plus change-triggered frames, transcribe locally with faster-whisper, page through section grids, and render a 16:9 study deck. Windows only, and needs the DSH pwsh tool plus Python 3.12 x64 with Pillow and FFmpeg/FFprobe; fetching adds yt-dlp, transcription needs faster-whisper with your own local model files, and deck output needs python-pptx.
description.zh: 视频精读：获取 B 站单分P或 YouTube 视频，每 3 秒基础采样并补取变化帧，本地 faster-whisper 转写，分页读取分段图版，并可排版成 16:9 学习 PPT。仅 Windows；需要 DSH 的 pwsh 工具，以及 Python 3.12 x64 + Pillow、FFmpeg/FFprobe；获取视频另需 yt-dlp，转写需 faster-whisper 并自备本地模型文件，PPT 输出需 python-pptx。

description.en: Follow list above the sidebar conversation list: a status dot per conversation (unread, waiting for you, running, failed), newest reply first, running ones last, and a follow toggle beside the model selector.
description.zh: 在侧边栏对话列表上方增加关注区：每行一个状态圆点（未读、待回复、运行中、失败），有新回复的置顶、运行中的置底，模型选择器左侧还有关注按钮。

description.en: Browse and continue DeepSeek web conversations in DSH, or import them with attachments into a workspace.
description.zh: 在 DSH 内浏览和继续 DeepSeek 网页会话，或将历史与附件导入工作区。

description.en: Password gate for the DeepSeek Harness Web UI that also removes the 403 a reverse proxy causes, with revocable sessions, an admin page and zero dependencies.
description.zh: 给 DSH Web UI 加密码登录，同时修掉反向代理导致的 403，带可吊销会话、管理页和零依赖。

description.en: WeCom smart bot over the official long connection (Bot ID + Secret, no public callback): persona, sender identity tags, three-layer memory with a forgetting curve, reminders, opt-in proactive chat, owner-only work mode guarded by tools.guard, auto-steer, image input and a wecomSoulBot host service; group chats answer when @-mentioned.
description.zh: 企业微信智能机器人官方长连接接入（Bot ID + Secret，无需公网回调）：人设、发送者身份标记、带遗忘曲线的三层记忆、提醒、可选主动搭话、由 tools.guard 拦截的仅主人工作模式、运行中自动插话、图片输入和 wecomSoulBot 宿主服务；群聊 @ 时回复。

description.en: A workbench beside DeepSeek Harness conversations with source navigation, Python class hierarchies, Git diffs, breakpoint debugging, and searchable Markdown memory cards. Go and Java navigation need their own language servers; breakpoint debugging needs separately installed debug adapters (debugpy, Delve, vscode-js-debug); Python class relationships are Python-only and in beta.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 对话旁的开发工作台，支持源码跳转、Python 类关系、Git 差异、断点调试与可搜索的 Markdown 记忆卡片。Go 与 Java 的源码跳转需自备语言服务器；断点调试需另行安装调试适配器（debugpy、Delve、vscode-js-debug）；Python 类关系仅支持 Python，且处于 beta。

description.en: Files the settings entries your installed plugins add below the ones dsh ships, behind a divider with a live count, and keeps up automatically as plugins come and go.
description.zh: 把已安装插件添加的设置入口统一收纳到 dsh 自带设置的下方，用带计数的分割线分区，插件增减时自动更新。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness 插件 — 投标符合性响应台账核对：依据《中华人民共和国招标投标法》《中华人民共和国招标投标法实施条例》（1999年8月30日通过，2017年12月27日修正、国务院令第613号）。仅提示差异，不作出定性结论。
description.zh: 按招标文件逐条核对投标响应台账，只提示漏项和差异，不替你下结论。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness 插件 — 出口管制物项台账核对：依据《中华人民共和国出口管制法》。仅提示差异，不作出定性结论。
description.zh: 按《出口管制法》核对出口管制物项台账与许可证，自动提示差异，不给定性结论。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness 插件 — HAZOP 分析表核对：依据《危险与可操作性分析（HAZOP分析）应用指南》（GB/T 35320-2017、GB/T 27921-2023）。仅提示差异，不作出定性结论。
description.zh: 检查 HAZOP 分析表是否合规：逐行核对模板要求的内容，并验证偏差是否真由工艺参数推出。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness 插件 — 论文投稿材料核对：依据《试题元数据规范》。仅提示差异，不作出定性结论。
description.zh: 检查试卷解析结果的结构是否自洽，确保每道题的题号、题干、答案和分值都齐全。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness 插件 — 家用汽车三包台账核对：依据《家用汽车产品修理更换退货责任规定》（市场监管总局令第43号）。仅提示差异，不作出定性结论。
description.zh: 检查质保索赔台账的算术和日期是否自洽，帮你在理赔前发现记录错误。

description.en: dsh plugin: per-host LLM outbound HTTP proxy routing (undici ProxyAgent) with a bundled dsh skill
description.zh: 把 LLM 请求按配置分流到指定代理，其余流量走系统代理，没配就直连。

description.en: Aliyun DashScope (Bailian) model provider preset for DeepSeek Harness: adds an OpenAI-compatible aliyun route with a starter Qwen catalog to the llm-pi-ai adapter.
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 接入阿里云百炼（DashScope）模型，自带通义千问系列，开箱即用。
